verdicts.why: Xandar never appears in Avengers: Infinity War; the MCU wiki lists the film as 'mentioned' only, with Thor saying Thanos decimated Xandar last week. Under the owner's rule a mention-only entry goes.

S.O.S. Part Two (#44) is set on the Iliad, the Playground and Boston, with no Afterlife; in S.O.S. Part One (#43) at Afterlife, Jiaying's staged shooting and Quinjet missile attack turn the Inhumans and Skye into agreeing to fight S.H.I.E.L.D.

In episode 12 Sallinger restrains Jessica at her apartment, she reveals she recorded his confession to killing Dorothy and leaves him for the police, and Trish murders him while he is taken to court. Jessica is not hunting him there, and Trish already turned vigilante earlier.
Tamaha is at 35.398 N, 94.987 W and covers about 17 square km, so the pin at -95.2 sits roughly 19 km west, well outside the town.

The owner's rule pins a place where any good source puts it, and The Art of Black Panther (the production design book) puts Wakanda in the East African Rift bordering DR Congo, Uganda and Rwanda, which matches the current pin. The Civil War map is a second valid placement, not a proof the pin is wrong.

The film names no state; the MCU wiki's Mojave/Nevada infobox is uncited, while the official adaptation Phase One: Marvel's The Avengers puts the facility in New Mexico, so the current filing rests on a source and passes.

In The Atomic Job (#13) Peggy's team breaks into the Roxxon warehouse in Los Angeles to disarm the atomic bombs Frost is after, and Peggy is impaled on rebar after fighting Frost. There is no chase through Hollywood.
In Stolen (#133) S.H.I.E.L.D. already keeps Jiaying at the Lighthouse for protection; Garrett teleports Nathaniel there, and Nathaniel tells her Daisy is her daughter before killing her.

Magneto offering Asteroid M to mutants and Cortez ejecting him happen in Sanctuary Part I (#48); in Part II (#49) Cortez runs the asteroid and fires hundreds of missiles at Earth until Magneto returns and destroys the missiles and the asteroid.

In #18 Spider-Man and Wolverine team up in Manhattan at Landon's building and the X-Men arrive by Blackbird; the mansion appears only as the War Room with no sourced event, no source has Rogue flirting, and Wolverine setting out to find Beast happens in #17. The entry does not happen at this place, so it goes.
